doorstep-video-easy v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Quickly edit and export doorstep or entry-area footage into 1080p MP4s, supporting MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Automatic cloud GPU processing with exports ready in 30–90 seconds.
- Simple workflows for trimming clips, adding title cards, and sharing videos for homeowners, real estate agents, and security-conscious users.
- Integrated credit and session management, with guided user setup and clear error handling.
- Streamlined upload, edit, preview, and export actions through intuitive text commands.
